flagship_project.name: Project Aurora-HyperScale: Real-Time Orbital Edge Hyperspectral Imagery Ingestion & Planetary Anomaly Alerting Mesh
flagship_project.pillar: Orbital Edge Computing & Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Analytics
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Downlinking raw hyperspectral satellite data across 300+ spectral bands creates massive bandwidth bottlenecks. Aurora-HyperScale deploys radiation-hardened edge AI on satellites to process, compress, and detect methane leaks, crop pestilence, and pipeline breaches in orbit, beaming down actionable alerts within minutes instead of days.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C / C++ (Radiation-Tolerant Satellite Flight Software), Rust (Downlink Processing Pipeline), Python / PyTorch (Spectral Signature Classification), Apache Arrow, Zarr (Multidimensional Scientific Imagery Store), AWS Ground Station
flagship_project.kpis: 90% reduction in satellite downlink bandwidth requirements; detects global methane leaks in under 15 minutes; sub-5-meter spectral resolution for precision agriculture.
